{{DISPLAYTITLE:Chronology}}
{{Noether's theorems map}}

[[File:NT-F-12.png|thumb|right|360px|alt=A horizontal timeline from 1891 to 2018 with nine marked events, Noether 1918 highlighted. A bracket beneath spans roughly 1921 to 1951, labelled as three decades in which the paper was little used.|A chronology from Lie to the anomaly]]

Every dated entry below is established on
[[Noether's theorems/History/Gottingen and the energy problem|the history
track]]. Entries whose date or attribution rests on secondary literature rather
than on a primary text are marked.

'''A caution that applies to the whole of 1918.''' Neither Noether's paper nor
Klein's second note reached its final form until September, after both had been
presented in July. What was said at either July session is not recoverable from
the printed papers, and this chronology dates the presentations and the
manuscripts separately for that reason.

{| class="wikitable"
! date !! event !! source
|-
| 1891 || Lie, ''Grundlagen für die Theorie der unendlichen kontinuierlichen Transformationsgruppen''. Cited by Noether at three points || her footnotes
|-
| Nov 1915 || Einstein publishes the field equations of general relativity || secondary
|-
| 20 Nov 1915 || Hilbert presents ''Die Grundlagen der Physik'', first communication || secondary
|-
| 23 Dec 1916 || Hilbert presents the second communication || secondary
|-
| 25 Jan 1918 || Klein presents his first note, on Hilbert's first communication. At the same session Klein presents Noether's ''Invarianten beliebiger Differentialausdrücke'' || secondary
|-
| 15 Feb 1918 || Noether, in a postcard to Klein from Erlangen, sketches the second theorem in a particular case || secondary
|-
| 12 Mar 1918 || Noether's letter to Klein gives a preliminary formulation of its essential consequence || secondary
|-
| spring 1918 || Weyl, ''Gravitation und Elektrizität''. Presented to the Berlin Academy; sources disagree between April and May, and the disagreement is unresolved || secondary
|-
| 19 Jul 1918 || Klein presents his second note, on the differential laws for the conservation of momentum and energy || primary, his paper
|-
| 23 Jul 1918 || Noether presents her results to the Göttingen Mathematical Society || secondary
|-
| 26 Jul 1918 || Klein presents ''Invariante Variationsprobleme'' to the Göttingen Scientific Society || '''primary, printed on the paper'''
|-
| mid-Sep 1918 || Klein's manuscript reaches final form || primary, his footnote
|-
| end Sep 1918 || Noether's manuscript reaches final form || '''primary, her footnote'''
|-
| 1918 || ''Invariante Variationsprobleme'' published, ''Nachrichten'' pages 235 to 257 || primary
|-
| Sep 1921 || Bessel-Hagen, ''Über die Erhaltungssätze der Elektrodynamik''. Divergence invariance enters here || secondary; the paper was not reached
|-
| 1921 || Klein's collected works appear, with a footnote restating both of Noether's theorems and Hilbert's assertion || secondary
|-
| 1924 || Hilbert reprints both communications, crediting Klein with the general derivation of the identities and Noether with the general proof || secondary
|-
| 1934 || first proper citation of Bessel-Hagen's paper, on the account of a study of its reception. '''This is a fact about his paper and not about Noether's''' || secondary
|-
| 1939, 1940 || Belinfante and Rosenfeld, the improvement of the stress-energy tensor || secondary, unverified
|-
| from 1949 || Bergmann and the constrained-Hamiltonian programme || secondary, unverified
|-
| 1951 || Hill's review article, commonly credited with putting the theorem before physicists || secondary, unverified
|-
| 1954 || Yang and Mills || secondary, unverified
|-
| 1956, 1961 || Utiyama, then Kibble, extend the gauge idea to gravitation || secondary, unverified
|-
| from 1962 || Trautman on conservation laws in general relativity || secondary, unverified
|-
| 1971 || Tavel's English translation, in ''Transport Theory and Statistical Physics'' || primary, located; under copyright
|-
| 2004, 2011 || Kosmann-Schwarzbach's study of the theorems, in French and then English || secondary
|-
| 2018 || centenary; renewed work returning to the paper itself || secondary
|}

Entries from 1939 onward are the route the secondary literature commonly gives.
None of the papers named there was read, and
[[Noether's theorems/History/The recovery in field theory|the page that carries
them]] says so.
